main_body: control tower building with upper observation deck, central shaft, and lower base building
top_band: light blue-grey sloped roof on upper deck (rows 8-17) and panelled roof on lower base (rows 51-61)
evidence: Both the upper observation cabin and the lower base building clearly show foreshortened top roof surfaces (rows 8-17 and 51-61) with lighter front-edge highlights (rows 15-16 and 60-61), darker eave bands beneath (rows 17-18 and 62), and vertical front faces with recessed windows and doors.

style.evidence: The candidate has a heavy, uniform pure-black outline around the silhouette and large flat fills of solid colour on the roofs, central shaft, and lower walls with almost no surface grain, whereas the Beodeul reference buildings use rich per-tile roof shading, stone/plaster textures, and tinted dark-material outlines.
